subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: Katherine Mansfield and Interior Life
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Katherine Mansfield and Interior Life.

hook.text: Katherine Mansfield wrote stories so precisely focused on inner feeling that Woolf considered her the only rival.

buildup.text: The Garden Party follows a girl preparing for a party while a working-class neighbor lies dead next door.

discovery.text: Mansfield captured how class privilege insulates people from suffering happening just beyond their garden wall.

twist.text: She died of tuberculosis at thirty-four, leaving behind a body of work that reshaped short fiction permanently.

climax.text: Mansfield proved that the short story could map the landscape of consciousness with the precision of a poem.

punchline.text: She mapped entire inner worlds in just a few pages.

quiz.question: What theme does The Garden Party explore?
options: The joy of planning outdoor events
How class privilege insulates people from others' suffering
